title: SYSK's Halloween Horror Fiction Winner!
summary: Hosts Josh and Chuck read aloud the winning entry of the Stuff You Should Know Halloween horror fiction contest, "Sign Forever and Ever" by Brett S. Arnold, chosen from over 100 entries (sweet sixteen bracket). Before the reading they discuss the contest, guest producer Matt, and contest runner-up Adam Practice's collection "Frame Story." The story alternates between Edmund, a man aboard a failing vessel near Mars, and voicemail-style messages he records to his daughter Sarah, in which he confesses to killing her mother years earlier and hiding the body in a frozen lake. The hosts close with Halloween wishes and contact information.

segments.title: Halloween opening and contest background
segments.summary: Josh and Chuck greet listeners ahead of Halloween and explain the horror fiction contest, which drew over 100 entries and produced a sweet sixteen.

segments.title: Contest winner announcement
segments.summary: The hosts announce Brett S. Arnold's story 'Sign Forever and Ever' as the winner and note that the sweet sixteen entries are posted on the HowStuffWorks blogs.

segments.title: Adam Practice's Frame Story promotion
segments.summary: Hosts promote Adam Practice's seven-story collection Frame Story, a sweet sixteen entrant, available as an ebook and print-on-demand book.

segments.title: Reading of 'Sign Forever and Ever'
segments.summary: Josh reads Edmund's sections and Chuck reads Edmund's recorded message to his daughter Sarah. Edmund's vessel is failing near Mars; in the messages he confesses to killing Sarah's mother with an axe, hiding her body in a frozen lake, and fleeing to Mars. He sends the message and dies of suffocation as the vessel breaks apart.

segments.title: Sign-off and contact information
segments.summary: Chuck wishes listeners a happy Halloween and gives social media and email contact details; Josh gives the HowStuffWorks website.
